lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of approximately 5-6 horizontal rows and 8-10 vertical columns of high-luminance, roughly circular blobs positioned posterior to the pectoral fin attachment.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating a localized grid of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from a high-intensity upper edge to a shaded ventral gradient.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small, irregularly spaced high-luminance spots that differ significantly in scale and organization from the primary flank constellation.
